title: E3 Protocol Message Schemas
description: JSON Schema definitions for E3 Application Protocol (E3AP) messages exchanged between dApps (E3 Manager) and E3 Agents, including E3 Service Model (E3SM) payload definitions for the NVIDIA KPM service model. Each telemetry ID maps to a specific stream; the setupResponse advertises the full set. Streams are delivered on either the PUSCH or SRS indication path depending on their type.

dAppId.description: dApp identifier assigned by the E3 Agent during setup

messageId.description: Monotonically increasing message identifier generated by the sender

data_stream.description: Data stream descriptor provided inside ranFunctionData of setupResponse

stream_id.description: Stream identifier (e.g., iq_samples, h_estimates, timestamp, sfn, mcs_index, srs_iq_samples, srs_hest, srs_rb_snr, srs_wideband_snr)

data_type.description: Data type string (e.g., array(int16), array(complex64), uint64, uint16, uint8, float32)

transport_type.description: How the data is delivered: via shared memory reference or inline in protocolData

memory_size_bytes.description: Size of shared memory region in bytes

keyword.description: JSON field name in protocolData (for inline delivery)

setupRequest.title: E3 Setup Request
setupRequest.description: Sent by dApp (E3 Manager) to E3 Agent via REQ/REP socket to establish connection. The agent assigns a dAppIdentifier and replies with setupResponse.

e3apProtocolVersion.description: E3AP protocol version supported by the dApp

dAppName.description: Name of the dApp (e.g., PRB Power)

setupResponse.title: E3 Setup Response
setupResponse.description: Sent by E3 Agent in reply to setupRequest via REQ/REP socket. On positive response, contains the assigned dAppIdentifier and available RAN functions with their data stream descriptors.

message.description: Error description when responseCode is negative

e3apProtocolVersion.description: E3AP protocol version supported by the agent

dAppIdentifier.description: Assigned dApp identifier (present on positive response)

ranIdentifier.description: Identifier of the RAN node (e.g., NVIDIA_L1)

ranFunctionList.description: List of RAN functions available for subscription

ranFunctionIdentifier.description: RAN function ID (e.g., 2 for NVIDIA KPM)

telemetryIdentifierList.description: Available telemetry stream IDs for this RAN function

controlIdentifierList.description: Available control IDs for this RAN function

ranFunctionData.description: Detailed stream descriptors including delivery method and metadata

subscriptionRequest.title: E3 Subscription Request
subscriptionRequest.description: Sent by dApp to E3 Agent via PUB socket to subscribe to telemetry streams on a specific RAN function. The agent confirms via subscriptionResponse on its own PUB socket.

ranFunctionIdentifier.description: RAN function to subscribe to (must match one from ranFunctionList)

telemetryIdentifierList.description: Telemetry stream IDs to subscribe to (from ranFunctionList)

controlIdentifierList.description: Control IDs to subscribe to (currently unused, send empty array)

periodicity.description: Indication delivery interval in microseconds. 0 = as fast as possible.

subscriptionTime.description: Subscription duration in seconds. 0 = indefinite (until explicit delete).

subscriptionResponse.title: E3 Subscription Response
subscriptionResponse.description: Sent by E3 Agent via PUB socket to confirm or reject a subscriptionRequest or subscriptionDelete. Matched to the original request via requestId. Also used as the response to subscriptionDelete.

requestId.description: id from the corresponding subscriptionRequest or subscriptionDelete

subscriptionId.description: Subscription identifier assigned by the agent (present on positive subscription). Also present in delete responses.

ranFunctionIdentifier.description: RAN function ID (echoed from request, present on positive subscription)

telemetryGrantedList.description: Telemetry IDs actually granted (may differ from requested)

periodicity.description: Granted periodicity in microseconds (may differ from requested)

message.description: Error description when responseCode is negative

subscriptionDelete.title: E3 Subscription Delete
subscriptionDelete.description: Sent by dApp to E3 Agent via PUB socket to cancel an active subscription. The agent confirms via subscriptionResponse.

indicationMessage.title: E3 Indication Message
indicationMessage.description: Sent by E3 Agent via PUB socket to deliver telemetry data to subscribed dApps. Indications arrive on two independent paths: PUSCH (per PUSCH slot) and SRS (per SRS slot). The protocolData field contains the actual payload; which fields are present depends on the subscribed telemetry identifiers. Shared memory streams provide buffer indices referencing POSIX shared memory, while scalar streams are delivered inline. PUSCH-path fields appear only in PUSCH indications; SRS-path fields appear only in SRS indications. Shared cell-level fields (timestamp, timestamp_tai, sfn, slot, cell_id, n_rx_ant_srs) appear in both when subscribed. See each field's description for its path affinity.

ranFunctionIdentifier.description: RAN function this indication belongs to

protocolData.description: Payload with telemetry streams. Fields present depend on subscribed telemetryIdentifierList.

timestamp_tai.description: TAI timestamp (ns) aligned from SFN/slot via grandmaster clock

iq_samples.description: Shared memory reference to IQ sample data (fronthaul)

fh_write_index.description: Current write row in the buffer

pdu_data.description: Shared memory reference to PUSCH PDU data

pusch_write_index.description: Current write row in the buffer

h_estimates.description: Shared memory reference to PUSCH channel estimates (concatenated per-group H blobs). Per-UE slicing metadata is in ue_metrics[].

hest_write_index.description: Slot index within the ping-pong buffer

hest_row_byte_offset.description: Byte offset within the buffer where this slot's H-estimate blob starts

n_rx_ant.description: Number of receive antennas (PUSCH path, telemetry ID 8)

n_rx_ant_srs.description: Number of SRS receive antennas (shared PUSCH/SRS, telemetry ID 9)

n_bs_ants.description: Number of base station antennas in PUSCH H estimates (telemetry ID 11)

n_ue.description: Number of PUSCH UEs in this slot (cell-level). Telemetry ID 34.

srs_iq_samples.description: Shared memory reference to raw SRS IQ sample data (cell-level). Telemetry ID 44.

srs_iq_write_index.description: Slot index within the ping-pong buffer

srs_iq_row_byte_offset.description: Byte offset within the buffer where this slot's SRS IQ blob starts

srs_hest.description: Shared memory reference to SRS channel estimates. Telemetry ID 45. Per-UE slicing via srs_hest_offset/srs_hest_size in ue_metrics[].

srs_hest_write_index.description: Current write row in the buffer

srs_rb_snr.description: Shared memory reference to SRS per-RB SNR. Telemetry ID 49. Per-UE slicing via srs_rb_snr_offset/srs_rb_snr_size in ue_metrics[].

srs_rb_snr_write_index.description: Current write row in the buffer

srs_cell_start_sym.description: SRS starting OFDM symbol index within the slot (cell-level). Telemetry ID 52.

srs_cell_n_srs_sym.description: Number of SRS OFDM symbols in this slot (cell-level). Telemetry ID 53.

n_srs_ue.description: Number of SRS UEs in this slot (cell-level). Telemetry ID 54.

ue_metrics.description: Per-UE metrics array. One element per scheduled UE. Present when any per-UE telemetry stream is subscribed. PUSCH indications populate PUSCH-specific fields; SRS indications populate SRS-specific fields. The rnti field is shared by both paths.

rnti.description: Radio Network Temporary Identifier (shared PUSCH/SRS, telemetry ID 33)

cb_errors.description: Code Block CRC error count (PUSCH, ID 17)

rsrp.description: Reference Signal Received Power in dB (PUSCH, ID 18)

noise_var.description: Noise+interference variance in dB, pre- or post-eq per enable_pusch_sinr, pre by default (PUSCH, ID 19)

sinr.description: SINR in dB, pre- or post-eq per enable_pusch_sinr, pre by default (PUSCH, ID 39)

cb_count.description: Number of Code Blocks per transport block (PUSCH, ID 20)

rssi.description: Received Signal Strength Indicator in dB, per-group (PUSCH, ID 21)

mcs_index.description: Modulation and Coding Scheme index 0-31 (PUSCH, ID 23)

rb_size.description: Number of allocated resource blocks, per-group (PUSCH, ID 26)

start_symbol_index.description: Start OFDM symbol index, per-group (PUSCH, ID 27)

nr_of_symbols.description: PUSCH duration in symbols, per-group (PUSCH, ID 28)

tb_size.description: Transport block size in bytes (PUSCH, ID 29)

pdu_len.description: PDU length: tb_size on CRC pass, 0 on fail (PUSCH, ID 30)

n_layers.description: Spatial layers for this UE (PUSCH, ID 12)

layer_offset.description: Starting layer in group H matrix, 0 for FDM (PUSCH, ID 35)

ue_grp_idx.description: cuPHY internal UE group index (PUSCH, ID 36)

h_offset.description: Element offset (float2) of group H data in SHM row (PUSCH, ID 37)

h_size.description: Element count (float2) of group H blob (PUSCH, ID 38)

n_dmrs_estimates.description: DMRS symbol count in group (PUSCH, ID 14)

dmrs_symb_pos.description: DMRS symbol position bitmask, per-group (PUSCH, ID 15)

cfo_hz.description: Carrier Frequency Offset in Hz (PUSCH, ID 43)

srs_hest_n_prb_grps.description: Number of PRB groups in SRS H-estimate grid (SRS, ID 46)

srs_hest_offset.description: Byte offset of UE H-estimate blob within SHM buffer (SRS, ID 47)

srs_hest_size.description: Byte count of UE H-estimate blob (SRS, ID 48)

srs_rb_snr_offset.description: Byte offset of UE RbSNR blob within SHM buffer (SRS, ID 50)

srs_rb_snr_size.description: Byte count of UE RbSNR blob (SRS, ID 51)

srs_wideband_snr.description: SRS wideband SNR in dB (SRS, ID 55)

srs_toa.description: SRS time of arrival in microseconds (SRS, ID 58)

srs_hd_ant_flag.description: SRS high-density antenna port flag, 1 = SNR unreliable (SRS, ID 59)

srs_sc_corr.description: SRS wideband subcarrier correlation [re, im] (SRS, ID 60)

srs_cs_corr_ratio_db.description: SRS correlation energy on used vs unused cyclic shifts in dB (SRS, ID 61)

srs_ant_ports.description: SRS number of antenna ports (SRS, ID 62)

srs_n_valid_prg.description: Number of valid PRB groups in SRS (SRS, ID 76)

dAppControlAction.title: dApp Control Action
dAppControlAction.description: Sent by dApp to E3 Agent via PUB socket to execute a control action on the RAN. The agent may optionally reply with a messageAck.

ranFunctionIdentifier.description: RAN function targeted by the control action

actionData.description: Control payload (contents depend on controlIdentifier and ranFunctionIdentifier)

releaseMessage.title: E3 Release Message
releaseMessage.description: Sent by either dApp or E3 Agent via PUB socket to tear down the E3 connection. Clears all active subscriptions and resets the dApp state. No response or acknowledgement is required; the receiver processes it locally.

messageAck.title: Message Acknowledgement
messageAck.description: Sent by E3 Agent via PUB socket as acknowledgement for received messages (e.g., dAppControlAction). Matched to the original message via requestId.

requestId.description: id from the message being acknowledged

message.description: Error description when responseCode is negative
